results.title: Illegal Alien Busted with Enough Fentanyl to Kill Nevada Twice, Prosecutors Say
results.description: WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW A Nevada speeding stop uncovered more than 700 pounds of suspected fentanyl and methamphetamine, federal prosecutors said. Prosecutors estimated the fentanyl represented seven million potentially lethal doses, enough to kill more than twice Nevada’s population.
